concept.anchor: to high solute concentration. A red blood cell placed in a hypotonic

spec.body_markdown:
| solution | water flow | RBC |
|---|---|---|
| hypotonic | into cell | swells, may lyse |
| isotonic (0.9% NaCl) | none net | normal |
| hypertonic | out of cell | crenates |

See [1] for micrographs.

concept.label: CFTR and cystic fibrosis
concept.anchor: Cystic fibrosis is caused by mutations in CFTR, a chloride channel
concept.context: CFTR chloride channel defect causes thick mucus.

spec.title: CFTR and cystic fibrosis
spec.caption: CFTR chloride channel defect causes thick mucus.
spec.body_markdown: CFTR is an ATP-gated **chloride channel**. The most common mutation, **F508del**, misfolds the protein so it never reaches the membrane [1]. Without Cl- secretion, water does not follow and mucus thickens [2].
